name: chatchat
description: Browser-first local multi-AI consultation: you propose, independent AIs consult as equals.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run check:product && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:web && npm run check:product
scripts.check:product: node scripts/check-product-language.mjs && node scripts/check-proposal-ownership.mjs && node scripts/check-readme-product-truth.mjs && node scripts/check-execution-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-history-surface-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-meeting-integrity.mjs && node scripts/check-receipt-integrity.mjs && node scripts/check-conflict-board.mjs
